declared_scope: The v0.12 parent stack plus a single reversible sysctl: vm.page-cluster=0 (channel: memory). Autonomously proposed; one knob added, nothing removed.
hypothesis: With a zram swap device (present in v0.12), vm.page-cluster=0 faults a single page per swap-in instead of a 8-page cluster, cutting wasted decompression under memory pressure. Expect the memory-pressure refault channel to improve vs v0.12 with no inference regression; other channels neutral.
rollback_method: Restores the prior vm.page-cluster value captured at apply time, then delegates the rest of the revert to the v0.12 preset undo; harness reverts at run end.
